notes: User ruling 2026-10-30, implemented in peer.mjs: EVERY unit (character or monster) enters with its class on the board (characters draw one / FORCE_CLASS; a monster's follows from its creature id). A class is destroyed COLOUR by colour — a colour is the stat group of its listed elements (the four Matter elements count as one colour), an adjacent enemy emits one of those elements and needs a die of 6 (class_colour_falls), one colour per action in any order; struck colours show en-gray in the unit list; when every colour is down the card goes to its OWNER's archive (class_colours_all_down) and its statics stop. The owner recasts it from the archive (back as initially) or untaps a tapped ability by emitting every colour with ANY successful point-buy, power 1 (class_progress_complete). Tap abilities are clicked in the permanents strip (reveal field class_ability); once-per-round and clickable static abilities are once per ACTION (hg.action). Context fields: caster.class_id, caster.class_down ([stats]), caster.class_archived, caster.class_tapped, caster.class_progress {mode, done}, caster.class_used_action, action.index, cast.elem (the element emitted against the colour), die, dist, target.*. UX: click an adjacent enemy's class colour chip twice, then the emission goes out on your Posture.

Ability (once per action): static: a stat / tile token I destroy under Rule 24 (or a world feature) is taken instead — a stat token goes into my holding, a tile token stays on its tile under my control; permanents are destroyed as usual. Paper text: "Instead of destroying tokens you may put them under your control on the same tile or over your permanent (as replacement if applicable)."

effects.description: The class colours (stat groups of its elements): W, M.
An adjacent enemy's emission of one of the colour's elements strikes the colour down on a die of 6 (one colour per action).
Every colour down → the card leaves the board for the owner's archive.
From the archive: emit every colour (any successful roll, power 1) → back on the board as initially.
Destroyed token taken instead (owner drops it, I gain it).
